evidence: The market news leading up to November 15, 2018, is dominated by severe bearish momentum and panic selling. Bitcoin decisively breached its major year-long support at $6,000, plunging into the $5,500-$5,600 range to mark fresh 12-month lows. Reports highlight technical capitulation, broad double-digit percentage market losses, and heightened disruption surrounding the Bitcoin Cash hard fork and related exchange halts. The violent breakdown of long-standing structural support and prevalent risk-off sentiment heavily tilt the 24-hour directional outlook downward.
limitations: Evidence consists entirely of unverified/other news records with zero authenticated live_yahoo records.
Non-immediate macro, CBDC, and exchange funding items were excluded from direct short-term price impact evaluation.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
